row.notes: Creates one VCQTC collision tile object per entry of a JPAK or BIGF container and returns its embedded sub-object (obj+0x1ef)&~0xf (sole caller Ne_MoverCollision_CreateResource 0x144453b6b). 2026-11-17 engine-re decode (static): takes an object from the world pool [world+0x40] (capacity +0x18 vs used +0x1c, compare at 0x1440caaea; the pool is sized from PhysicsWorldConfig maxLargeGeoms, see Ne_PhysWorld_InitFromConfig), else error 0xc and returns 0. Tile header: +0 version (vanilla 0x20004; <= 0x20001 = fatal trap Ne_FatalFormat_Trap, jle at 0x1440cad08 -> 0x1440cc1e2), +4..+0x1c AABB (x and z read), +0x1c tri count (not read here), +0x20 vert count, +0x24 material count, +0x28/+0x30/+0x38/+0x40 offsets of vertices (16-byte x,y,z,w)/nodes/triangles/leaves, relocated to pointers in place; +0x2c/+0x34 floats copied to obj+0x1a0/+0x1a4 (v > 0x20002, cmp at 0x1440cacdc; the legacy path overwrites them with the min/max Y of the non-tall triangles). Material ids (u32 at +0x50) are replaced IN PLACE by 8-byte material pointers (loop from the last id down), so the header must reserve 8 bytes per material before the vertex block (vanilla: 8 materials, vertices at 0x90); an unknown non-zero id logs error 2 and falls back to the first material (id 0 not found: first material, no log). Bit i of obj+0x1d0 = material i flag (+0x38). Legacy branch (version < 0x20003: cmp at 0x1440cad95, jg at 0x1440cad9b, and only with a vertex count > 0) converts old node trees and writes the leaf word itself: u32 = tallWallCount<<26 | ((trunc(50*maxY_all) - trunc(50*maxY_nonTall)) & 0x7ff)<<15 | (0x4001 + trunc(50*maxY_all)) & 0x7fff (0x1440cbabd..0x1440cbae7; the dY field is zeroed by cmove when all tris are tall walls), then u8 total tris, u8 ground tris, u16 tri indices (ground first, then walls, then tall walls), a u16 0xffff pad when the triangle count is even (0x1440cb5c8..0x1440cb5d4), then one dword per triangle of four quantised XZ box bytes. Ground = normal.y >= 0.25 or max dy <= 0.335 m; tall wall = |normal.y| < 0.05 and max dy > 4 m. Triangle = 4 bytes: v0 = ((b0 & 3) << 8) | b1, v1 = v0 + b2, v2 = v0 + b3. Tiles of version > 0x20002 keep the file's leaf words (no recompute). | engine-re 2026-11-17 track round C (surface): tile material ids. Header count piVar30[9], ids as a packed u32 array at header+0x50 (read [rsi+r15*4+0x50]), resolved backwards in place to 8-byte pointers ([rsi+r15*8+0x50]) into the physics material library [[ctx+0xe8]+0x28] (active byte +0x20, entries +8, count +0x10, stride +0x18; entry +0 = 4-char code, the MATERIALS records of Ne_Phys_ParseMaterials): linear search by code (store 0x1440caee2, library 0x1440caefa); an id 0 with no entry of code 0 (silently) or a nonzero code not in the library (NEerrno 2, written to the trace ring 0x146107830 when ring recording is on for the thread) -> the FIRST library entry; null only when the library byte +0x20 is 0 or its entries pointer [lib+8] is null (0x1440caf30; a count of 0 skips the search and stores the entries pointer [lib+8] itself) (V11210). So a tile with an unknown ground code drives like library entry 0, not like tarmac. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: corrected the fatal and legacy branch addresses, the null fallback and the caller's containers from the blind partial V20011. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: the pool compare address, the id 0 and empty-library cases from the blind partial. | re-bindings 2026-11-18: the leaf pad from the blind partial.
